text.p: Abbey National Plc and Bank of Scotland Plc were upgraded at Lehman Brothers, analyst Robert Law at the investment bank said on Tuesday.
Abbey was raised to "outperform" from "underperform" due to a more positive view of the bank's ability to market a wider range of retail products, Law said.
Bank of Scotland was upped to ""outperform" from "neutral" due to a positive view on its ability to grow faster than its competitors over the longer term.
Abbey shares were up 4p at 789 by 1021 GMT, extending its steady rise since the start of the month, in active trade of 2.9 million shares.
Bank of Scotland, stuck in a narrow range around 320p since late March, was up 3p at 316 in volume of just under one million.
